name: 28779 · Sylva, NC
findings: ZIP 28779 (Sylva) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28779 (Sylva) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28779 (Sylva) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
